sections.key: # Process — Notice, Summons, Warrant, Proclamation, Attachment

v12 — 2026-10-19; order items' variables are no longer locked or optional, and order items carry no template text (see [`dropped-ideas.md`](dropped-ideas.md)); links point at the e-filing handover, after the e-filing, scrutiny and registration handover was split in two. v11 — 2026-10-18; **court-side work is named by role** ([`court-roles.md`](court-roles.md)): a warrant is signed by a **Warrant signer**, every other process by a **Process signer** (`SGN-01`); marking sent, recording the outcome and recording a recall are done by a **Process dispatcher** (§6.2, `DSP-03`, `PIA-01`); the channels and police station are order data. The CMO and Magistrate no longer hold permissions here. v10 — 2026-09-30; 2026-10-15: **new By hand channel** (§6.2) — no envelope, no destination; the CMO marks it sent and records the outcome. Warrant may take it; **a proclamation takes By hand only**, and a screen may record it Sent and Executed once the signed copy is downloaded (`DSP-10`); `Q-2` resolved for affixation. **System send is still its own step** — whether a screen sends on signing is a UI choice (`DSP-02`). 2026-10-12: **recipient vs addressee clarified** (§2) — the recipient is the person the process names and never changes; a warrant, proclamation or attachment is *addressed* to the police; "addressee" no longer used for the person named (`SGN-01`, `DSP-04`, `PIA-01`, `Q-2`). **police is now a channel, not a flag.** The channels are
